remarks: Welcome to this move-in ready large 1 bed 1 bath condo in the heart of Stamford's Cove neighborhood. This is one of the largest units in the building and the only one with a private oversized patio/terrace. As you enter the unit, you have a large hallway with the updated kitchen with newer stainless steel appliances and new countertops. The living room opens up to the beautiful large terrace. The outdoor space is perfect to be used in all seasons and great for entertaining. The bedroom also has a slider that opens up to the terrace. The whole unit has updated flooring, lighting and new washer/dryer for convenience. This condo comes with one assigned parking and additional visitors parking bays are available. There is plenty of storage in the unit and one assigned storage unit in the building. Close to beach, Cove island and Chelsea piers. Convenient location for commuting. This is a must see!
